encoding: 8-bit scalar, WebP quality85 effort6, 4096x2048 unchanged, NoColorSpace
algorithm: linear HDR 2x2 average; log(red/blue); 6th/92nd percentile envelopes per elevation, Gaussian-smoothed sigma18 rows; smooth coverage; source sun 3–7 degree mask to neutral; neutral lower hemisphere; 8-column periodic edge feather
limitations: Estimated cloud coverage, not calibrated physical optical depth.
No original RGB or radiance is included in the data texture.
4K angular detail is appropriate for thin soft clouds, not a sharp photographic background.
